_spotComment: Read the metals.dev feed the portfolio app already collects on this Pi.
We never poll metals.dev directly: two pollers would drift, and the
portfolio and this tool would quote different premiums for the same
metal on the same day. Point 'path' at the portfolio store and adjust
table/column names to match its schema.
_accountDeletionComment: eBay will not activate a production keyset until you either subscribe to
Marketplace Account Deletion notifications or are granted an exemption.
Run 'notify-endpoint' behind your reverse proxy, register endpointUrl with
eBay, then confirm with 'notify-check'. The endpoint URL is part of the
challenge hash, so it must match byte for byte - and the path must NOT sit
behind an auth gate, because eBay calls it unauthenticated.
